name: general practice
trans: n. 全科诊所；一般医师

name: health center
trans: n. 健康中心

name: clinic
trans: n. a medical establishment run by a group of medical specialists

name: infirmary
trans: n. a health facility where patients receive treatment

name: emergency
trans: n. a sudden unforeseen crisis (usually involving danger) that requires immediate action; a state in which martial law applies

name: outpatient
trans: n. a patient who does not reside in the hospital where he is being treated

name: practitioner
trans: n. someone who practices a learned profession

name: dentist
trans: n. a person qualified to practice dentistry

name: veterinarian
trans: n. a doctor who practices veterinary medicine

name: surgeon
trans: n. a physician who specializes in surgery

name: physician
trans: n. a licensed medical practitioner

name: physicist
trans: n. a scientist trained in physics

name: have a flu
trans: 患流感

name: have a cold
trans: 感冒

name: infectious
trans: adj. caused by infection or capable of causing infection; easily spread

name: fever
trans: n. a rise in the temperature of the body; frequently a symptom of infection; intense nervous anticipation

name: headache
trans: n. something or someone that causes anxiety; a source of unhappiness

name: cough
trans: n. a sudden noisy expulsion of air from the lungs that clears the air passages…
v. exhale abruptly, as when one has a chest cold or congestion

name: sneeze
trans: n. a symptom consisting of the involuntary expulsion of air from the nose
v. exhale spasmodically, as when an irritant entered one's nose

name: have a stuffed nose
trans: 鼻塞

name: have a running nose
trans: 流鼻涕

name: have a sore throat
trans: 咽喉痛

name: have a dry throat
trans: 咽喉干燥

name: have sore eyes
trans: 眼睛酸痛

name: shoulder
trans: n. the part of the body between the neck and the upper arm

name: back
trans: n. the posterior part of a human (or animal) body from the neck to the end of the spine; the side that goes last or is not normally seen

name: wrist
trans: n. a joint between the distal end of the radius and the proximal row of carpal bones

name: elbow
trans: n. hinge joint between the forearm and upper arm and the corresponding joint in the forelimb of a quadruped; a sharp bend in a road or river

name: knee
trans: n. hinge joint in the human leg connecting the tibia and fibula with the femur and protected in front by the patella

name: toe
trans: n. one of the digits of the foot; the part of footwear that provides a covering for the toes

name: waist
trans: n. the narrowing of the body between the ribs and hips

name: finger
trans: n. any of the terminal members of the hand (sometimes excepting the thumb)

name: ankle
trans: n. a gliding joint between the distal ends of the tibia and fibula and the proximal end of the talus

name: get a pounding
trans: 受到撞击

name: sprain
trans: n. a painful injury to a joint caused by a sudden wrenching of its ligaments
v. twist suddenly so as to sprain

name: insomnia
trans: n. an inability to sleep; chronic sleeplessness

name: vomit
trans: n. the matter ejected in vomiting
v. eject the contents of the stomach through the mouth

name: allergy
trans: n. hypersensitivity reaction to a particular allergen; symptoms can vary greatly in intensity
